rows.text: R. C. Tripathi, Returning Officer for the Presidential Election, 2002, declares under section 11 of the Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act, 1952 read with rule 35 of the 1974 Rules that Shri Abdul Kalam (House No. 833, Nikka Singh Block, Asiad Village Complex, New Delhi) has been duly elected to the office of President of India; the declaration is dated New Delhi, 18 July 2002.

locator.item: DECLARATION (quoted inside S.O. 763(E)), English and Hindi columns

rows.text: The Ministry of Law and Justice (Legislative Department) publishes the declaration containing the name of the person elected to the office of President of India, in pursuance of section 12 of the 1952 Act, by notification S.O. 763(E) of 18 July 2002 [F. No. H. 11024(4)/2002-Leg.II], signed by Dr. Subhash C. Jain, Secretary.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
